thread:
incident-bot: PAGER: runtime-queue-alert - High queue length on runtime-pool-4 for service: inference-api (>= 95th pct for 3m)
sam: I'm on it, grabbing logs and checking inflight counts.
sam: prelim: lots of long-running requests from tenant acme-inc hitting 1k token contexts, KV cache thrash.
jordan: seeing 6xx and a few timeouts in the ingress LB. Token/sec spiky, queuing backlog on pool-4.
priya: any customer impact reported by support?
support: support: couple customers reported 503s and slow responses ~2-3 mins, one escalation (acme).
maria: if it's long-context requests, we should consider disabling long-context encoding path and lower max_inflight for that pool.
sam: agreed. Current pool config: max_inflight=24, backpressure_threshold=0.8, client_shed=off.
sam: can we reduce max_inflight to 10 as a quick mitigation? That should reduce mem/KV pressure.
jordan: +1. Also enable request_shedding for requests >30s and set timeout=45s to avoid head-of-line blocking.
priya: i'll open the change and ping infra to apply. ETA ~2m.
priya: /ops apply-config runtime-pool-4 --set max_inflight=10 --set request_shedding.enabled=true --set request_shedding.threshold_ms=30000 --set request_timeout_ms=45000
opsbot: Config change submitted: change-id=chg_20260317_001. Applying to runtime-pool-4...
opsbot: change-id=chg_20260317_001: rollout started (gradual across 3 zones)
sam: monitoring inflight and p95 latency.
maria: also propose a quick quota bump for acme-inc to dedicated capacity to avoid impacting paid SLAs, route via dedicated-route if capacity available.
support: acme is ok with a temporary route if you can patch them over, they flagged this as production-impacting.
jordan: I can create a routing override: add routing rule for tenant acme-inc -> dedicated-pool-2 (if capacity free). Doing dry-run.
jordan: dry-run ok, now applying: /routing apply --tenant acme-inc --to dedicated-pool-2 --ttl 2h
opsbot: Routing change applied: route-id=r_3421098765_acme -> dedicated-pool-2 (ttl 7200s)
sam: good. After max_inflight reduction, queue length dropped ~45% in the last 90s. p95 latency trending down.
priya: request_shedding triggered ~120 requests in last minute, those were mostly >35s.
maria: note: shedding will surface 429 to some users. support, pls coordinate customer comms for acme.
support: on it. Sending note to acme PM and CSM now.
sam: next step: tune per-tenant concurrency limits to avoid single-tenant lockdown. For now set tenant_max_inflight(acme)=6 while on dedicated route.
jordan: applied tenant cap: tenant_max_inflight=6 for acme-inc. Verifying.
jordan: verified. acme traffic now flows to dedicated pool and respects cap.
priya: opsbot reports rollout success for config change: change-id=chg_20260317_001 succeeded across zones.
opsbot: change-id=chg_20260317_001: success
sam: handoff: i'm going offline in ~30m, maria you're on primary after that. Logging runbook notes in #incidents.
maria: got it. I'll monitor SLA dashboards and keep the route for 2h then re-evaluate.
priya: follow-up tasks: 1) investigate long-context KV eviction policy 2) add automated tenant throttling for heavy context sizes 3) postmortem if acme saw >1min degraded.
support: acme notified, ops will follow up with timeline.
sam: thanks everyone. leaving note: if we see reoccurrence, escalate to runtime-ml for kernel-level caching fix.
maria: copying this into handoff: handoff_ts=3421100200, oncall_next=maria, mitigations_applied=[max_inflight=10,request_shedding=30s,request_timeout=45s,routing=acme->dedicated-pool-2,tenant_cap=6]
incident-bot: Incident updated: severity=high -> mitigated, tracking_id=INC-3421098765
maria: closing thread here, will update if anything regresses. :thumbsup:
